_comment: Hand-written placement for Vale of Mularn. The client ships no spawn data -- the server places every creature -- so these positions, and the fighting numbers, are this project's own, not the live game's. x and y are heightmap cells (256 units each), the same as daoc.warp(); radius is in cells too. char names a directory under web/data/char/. idle is the range of seconds to stand between wanders. hp, damage [min, max], swing (seconds) and hit (chance) are for combat; aggro is how close, in units, the player may come before it attacks unprovoked (0: only fights back). Attacking one of a group brings its packmates within 900 units in too.
